Haqqa Qiyamat ka aik naam hai aur is naam ki wajah yeh hai ke waade waeed ki amli ta'beer aur haqeeqat ka din wahi hai, isi liye is din ki holnaki bayaan karte hue farmaya tum is Haqqa ki sahih kaifiyat se bekhabar ho, phir un logon ka zikr farmaya jin logon ne ise jhutlaya aur khumiyaza uthaya tha toh farmaya Samudiyon ko dekho aik taraf se farishte ke dahaade aur kalejon ko paash paash karde dene wali aawaz aati hai toh dusri janib se zameen mein gazabnaak bhoumchal aata hai aur sab teh o baala hojate hain, pas ba-qaul Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) ke ma'ni changhaar ke hain, aur Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain isse murad gunah hain yaani woh apne gunahon ke baa'is barbaad kardiye gaye, Rabi' bin Anas (R.H) aur Ibn Zaid (R.H) ka qaul hai ke isse murad un ki sarkashi hai. Ibn Zaid (R.H) ne iski shahadat mein yeh aayat padhi (Kazzabat Samudu bi-taghwaha 11) (Ash-Shams: 11) yaani Samudiyon ne apni sarkashi ke baa'is jhutlaya, yaani oontni ki kochein kaat dien aur Qaum-e-Aad ki thandi hawaon ke tez jhonkon se dil chhed diye aur woh nist o nabood kardiye gaye, yeh aandhiyan jo khair o barkat se khaali hain aur farishton ke haathon se nikalti thiin barabar pe dar pe lagataar saat raatein aur aath din tak chalti rahin, un dinon mein un ke liye siwaaye nuhusat o barbadi ke aur koi bhalayi na thi aur jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Fa arsalna 'alaihim rihan sarsaran fi ayyamin nahisatin linuziqahum azabal-khizyi fil-hayatid-dunya wa la-azabul-akhirati akhza wa hum la yunsarun) (Fussilat: 16).

(Fussilat: 16) Hazrat Rabie farmate hain jumumah ke din se yeh shuru hui thin, ba'z kehte hain budh ke din. In hawaon ko arab-e-ajaz is liye bhi kehte hain ke Quran ne farmaya hai Qoum-e-Ad ki halat ajaz yaani khajooron ke khokhlay tanon jaisi ho gayi. Doosri wajah yeh bhi hai ke umoman yeh hawain jaron ke aakhir mein chala karti hain aur ajaz kehte hain aakhir ko. Aur yeh wajah bhi bayan ki jati hai ke Qoum-e-Ad ki aik burhiya aik ghar mein ghus gayi thi jo in hawaon se aathwein roz wahin tabaah ho gayi aur burhiya ko arabi mein ajouz kehte hain, Wallahu A'lam. (Khawiyah) ke ma'ni hain kharab, gala, sara, khokhla. Matlab yeh hai ke hawaon ne unhein utha utha kar ulta diya, un ke sar phat gaye, saron ka choora choora ho gaya aur baaqi jism aisa reh gaya jaise khajoor ke drakhton ka paton wala sira kaat kar sirf tana rehne diya ho. Bukhari Muslim ki hadith mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain: Saba ke sath meri madad ki gayi yaani mashriqi hawa ke sath aur Adi halak kiye gaye dabour se yaani maghribi hawa se. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: Adiyon ko halak karne ke liye hawaon ke khazane mein se sirf angothi ke barabar jagah kushada ki gayi thi jis se hawain niklin aur pehle woh gaon aur dehat walon par aayin, un tamam mardon aur aurton ko, chote baron ko un ke malon aur janwaron samit le kar aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan muallaq kar diya. Shehriyon ko bujh-e-bohat bulandi aur kaafi oonchai ke yeh maloom hone laga ke yeh siyah rang baadal charha hua hai, khush hone lage ke garmi ke baais jo hamari buri halat ho rahi hai ab pani baras jayega, itne mein hawaon ko hukam hua aur us ne un tamam ko un shehriyon par phenk diya, yeh aur woh sab halak ho gaye. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain is hawa ke par aur dum thi. Phir farmata hai batao ke un mein se ya un ki nasl mein se kisi aik ka nishan bhi tum dekh rahe ho? Yaani sab ke sab tabaah-o-barbaad kar diye gaye koi nam lene wala pani dene wala bhi baaqi na raha. Phir farmaya Firaun aur us se agle khata-kar aur Rasul ke na-farman ka yahi anjam hua. (Qablah) ki doosri qirat (Qibalah) bhi hai to ma'ni yeh honge ke Firaun aur us ke paas aur sath ke log yaani Firauni, Qibti, kuffar. (Mautafikaat) se murad bhi paighambaron ki jhutlane wali agli ummaten hain. (Khatah) se matlab masiyat aur khataein hain, pas farmaya un mein se har aik ne apne apne zamane ke Rasul ki takzeeb ki, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (In kullun illa kazzabar-rusula fahaqqa 'iqabi) (Sad: 14) yaani un sab ne rusul ki takzeeb ki aur un par azab nazil hue aur yeh bhi yaad rahe ke aik paighambar ka inkar goya tamam ambiya ka inkar hai jaise Quran ne farmaya ayat (Kazzabat qoumu Nuhin-il-mursalin) (Ash-Shu'ara: 105) aur farmaya ayat (Kazzabat 'Adun-il-mursalin) (Ash-Shu'ara: 123) aur farmaya ayat (Kazzabat Samudul-mursalin) (Ash-Shu'ara: 141).

(Ash-Shu'ara: 141) Yaani Qaum-e-Nuh ne, Adiyon ne, Samudiyon ne Rasoolon ko jhutlaya, halanki sab ke paas yaani har har ummat ke paas ek hi Rasool aaya tha, yehi matlab yahan bhi hai ke unhon ne apne Rabb ke paigambar ki nafarmani ki, pas Allah ne unhe sakht tar, muhlik, bari, dardnak, almanaq pakar mein pakar liya. Ba'd azaan apna ehsaan jatata hai ke dekho jab Nuh (Alaihis Salam) ki dua ki wajah se zameen par tufan aaya aur pani had se guzar gaya, charon taraf rail-pehel ho gayi, nijat ki koi jagah na rahi, us waqt hum ne tumhein kashti mein charha liya. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke jab Qaum-e-Nuh ne apne Nabi ko jhutlaya aur unki mukhalifat aur izaa-rasani shuru ki, Allah ke siva dusron ki ibadat karne lage, us waqt Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam) ne tang aa kar unki halakat ki dua ki jise Allah Ta'ala ne qubool farma liya aur mashhoor tufan-e-Nuh nazil farmaya jis se siwaye un logon ke jo Hazrat Nuh ki kashti mein the, ruye zameen par koi na bacha, pas sab log Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam) ki nasl aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aulaad mein se hain. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain ke pani ka ek ek qatra ba-ijazat-e-Allah pani ke darogha farishte ke naap-tol se barsta hai, isi tarah hawa ka halka sa jhonka bhi be-naape-tole nahi chalta, lekin haan Adiyon par jo hawayein chalein aur Qaum-e-Nuh par jo tufan aaya woh to behad, beshumar aur baghair naap-tol ke tha, Allah ki ijazat se pani aur hawa ne woh zor bandha ke nigehban farishton ki kuch na chali, isi liye Quran mein ayat (Inna lamma taghal-ma'u hamalnakum fil-jariyah) (Al-Haqqah: 11) aur ayat (Wa amma 'adun fa-uhliku bi-rihin sarsarin 'atiyah) (Al-Haqqah: 6) ke alfaz hain. Isi liye is ahem ehsaan ko Allah Ta'ala yaad dila raha hai ke aise pur-khatar mauqa par hum ne tumhein chalti kashti par sawar kara diya taake yeh kashti tumhare liye namuna ban jaye, chunacha aaj bhi waisi hi kashtiyon par sawar ho kar samundar ke lambe chaude safar te kar rahe ho, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa ja'ala lakum minal-fulki wal-an'ami ma tarkabun) (Az-Zukhruf: 12), yaani tumhare sawari ke liye kashtiyan aur chaupaye janwar banaye taake tum un par sawari karo aur sawar ho kar apne Rabb ki nemat yaad karo. Aur jagah farmaya ayat (Wa ayatul lahum anna hamalna zurriyatahum fil-fulkil-mashhun) (Yasin: 41) yaani unke liye ek nishan-e-qudrat yeh bhi hai ke hum ne unki nasl ko bhari kashti mein charha liya aur bhi hum ne is jaisi unki sawariyan paida kar-deen.

Zahir-o-Batin Ayat-e-Ilahi

Allah Ta'ala apni makhlooq mein se apni un nishaniyon ki qasam kha raha hai jinhe log dekh rahe hain aur un ki bhi jo logon ki nigahon se poshida hain, is baat par ke Quran-e-Kareem Us ka kalam aur Us ki wahi hai jo Us ne apne bande aur apne barguzida Rasool ﷺ par utari hai, jise Us ne ada-e-amanat aur tabligh-e-risalat ke liye pasand farma liya hai. Rasool Kareem se murad Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ hain, is ki izafat Huzoor ﷺ ki taraf is liye ki gayi ke is ke mablagh aur pohnchane wale Aap ﷺ hi hain. Isi liye lafz Rasool laye kyunke Rasool to paigham apne bhejne wale ka pohnchata hai go zaban us ki hoti hai lekin kaha huwa bhejne wale ka hota hai. Yahi wajah hai ke Surah Takweer mein is ki nisbat us Rasool ki taraf ki gayi hai jo farishton mein se hain, farman hai Ayat (Innahu laqawlun rasoolin kareem) 69. Al-Haqqah: 40, yani yeh qaul us buzurg Rasool ﷺ ka hai jo quwwat wala aur malik-e-arsh ke paas rehne wala hai wahan is ka kehna mana jata hai aur hai bhi woh amanat-dar, is se murad Hazrat Jibrail A.S hain, isi liye is ke baad farmaya tumhare sathi yani Muhammad ﷺ majnoon nahi balki Aap ﷺ ne Hazrat Jibrail ko un ki asli surat mein saaf kinaron par dekha bhi hai aur woh poshida ilm par bukhail bhi nahi, na yeh shaitan-e-rajeem ka qaul hai, isi tarah yahan bhi irshad hota hai ke na to yeh shair ka kalam hai na kahin ka qaul hai albatta tumhare iman mein aur naseehat hasil karne mein kami hai, pas kabhi to apne kalam ki nisbat Rasool unsi ki taraf ki aur kabhi Rasool mulki ki taraf, is liye ke yeh is ke pohnchane wale lane wale aur is par amin hain, han darasal kalam kis ka hai? Use bhi sath hi sath bayan farma diya ke yeh utara huwa Rabb-ul-Alameen ka hai. 

Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A apne islam lane se pehle ka apna waqia bayan karte hain ke main Aap ﷺ ke paas gaya dekha ke Aap ﷺ Masjid-e-Haram mein pohnch gaye hain, main bhi gaya aur Aap ﷺ ke peeche khara ho gaya Aap ﷺ ne Surah Al-Haqqah shuru ki jise sun kar mujhe is ki pyari nishat alfaz aur bandish-e-mazamin aur fasahat-o-balaghat par taajjub aane laga akhir mein mere dil mein khayal aaya ke Quraish theek kehte hain yeh shakhs shair hai, abhi main isi khayal mein tha ke Aap ﷺ ne yeh aayatein tilawat kiin ke yeh qaul Rasool Kareem ka hai shair ka nahi tum mein iman hi kam hai, to main ne kaha acha shair na sahi kahin to zaroor hai, idhar Aap ﷺ ki tilawat mein yeh aayat aayi ke yeh kahin ka qaul bhi nahi tum ne naseehat hi kam li hai, ab Aap ﷺ padhte chale gaye yahan tak ke poori surat khatam ki. Farmate hain yeh pehla mauqa tha ke mere dil mein islam poori tarah ghar kar gaya aur rowein rowein mein islam ki sachai ghus gayi, pas yeh bhi minjumla un asbab ke jo Hazrat Umar R.A ke islam ka baais hue ek khas sabab hai, hum ne Aap R.A ke islam lane ki poori kaifiyat Seerat-e-Umar mein likh di hai. Walillah-il-Hamdu wal-Minnah

Hidayat aur Shifa Quran-e-Hakeem:

Yahan farman-e-Bari hai ke jis tarah tum kehte ho agar fi-waqayi hamare yeh Rasool aise hi hote ke hamari risalat mein kuch kami beshi kar daalte ya hamari na kahi hui baat hamare naam se bayaan kar dete toh yaqinan usi waqt hum unhein badtareen saza dete yaani apne dayein haath se uska daiyan haath thaam kar uski woh rag kaat daalte jis par dil moallaq hai aur koi hamare iske darmiyan bhi na aa sakta ke use bachane ki koshish kare, pas matlab yeh hua ke Huzoor-e-Risalat-Ma'ab ﷺ sache paak-baaz rushd-o-hidayat wale hain isi liye Allah ne zabardast tablighi khidmat Aap ﷺ ko saunp rakhi hai aur apni taraf se bahut se zabardast mojize aur Aap ﷺ ke sidq ki behtareen badi badi nishaniyan Aap ﷺ ko inayat farma rakhi hain. 

Phir farmaya yeh Quran muttaqiyon ke liye tazkira hai, jaise aur jagah hai keh do yeh Quran imandaron ke liye hidayat aur shifa hai aur be-imaan toh andhe behre hain hi, phir farmaya bawajood is safai aur khule haq ke humein ba-khoobi maloom hai ke tum mein se baaz ise jhoota batlate hain, yeh takzeeb un logon ke liye Qiyamat ke din baais-e-hasrat-o-afsos hogi, ya yeh matlab ke yeh Quran aur is par iman haqiqatan kuffar par hasrat ka baais hoga, jaise aur jagah hai, isi tarah hum ise gunahgaron ke dilon mein utaarte hain phir woh is par iman nahi laate. 

Aur jagah hai: 
(Wa hila baynahum wa bayna ma yashtahouna kama fu'ila bi-ashyadihim min qablu innahum kanu fi shakkin mureebin) (Saba: 54) 
Un mein aur un ki khwahish mein hijab daal diya gaya hai, phir farmaya yeh khabar bilkul sach, haq aur beshak-o-shubha hai, phir apne Nabi ﷺ ko hukum deta hai ke is Quran ke nazil karne wale Rabb-e-Azeem ke naam ki buzurgi aur pakizgi bayaan karte raho. 

Allah ke fazl se Surah Al-Haqqah ki tafsir khatam hui.
